node.statement: The amplified defect of T. For X,Y in M_n tensor M_r, def-extended-delta-inclusion gives ||v_n(XY)-v_n(X) dot v_n(Y)||<=delta||X||||Y||, ||v_n(X)||<=(1+delta)||X||, exact dagger preservation, and the corresponding unit estimate in the compressed algebra S_P. The upper, product, unit and adjoint clauses of conj-hcb for h_11,n therefore give ||T_n(XY)-T_n(X)T_n(Y)|| <= (1+C_H*e)delta||X||||Y||+C_H*e*(1+delta)^2||X||||Y|| and ||T_n(I)-I||<=A_0*e; dagger is exact. For e below one universal bound, both defects are <=A_0*e with A_0=4(C_H+1), independent of n,r and dim A. Thus node 1.2 applies and supplies one exact unital dagger-homomorphism mu_11 with complete distance at most kappa*e, kappa=C_corr*A_0.
